## Changes

Describe the customer-facing change and any store-wide catalog/settings changes made separately.

## Verification

- [ ] Theme Check, regression tests, accessibility checks and asset budgets pass.
- [ ] Draft-theme mobile/desktop preview verified with installed apps.
- [ ] No unsupported fitment, shipping, stock, review or performance claims added.
- [ ] Cart restored; checkout/payment tests use a separately approved workflow.
- [ ] No private CSVs, customer data, checkout tokens or credentials included.

## Release Decision

- [ ] Authoritative repository and Shopify-connected branch verified.
- [ ] Owner approves the live update separately; merging a connected branch can update the live theme.
- [ ] Current live theme/settings backed up and rollback target recorded privately.
- [ ] Store-level changes and unresolved checks documented in RELEASE-READINESS.md.

This PR does not automatically deploy or certify launch readiness.
